subject: Samplig weight in the context of complex sampling design (e.g., PISA, TIMMS, ICCS)

messages.author: 917886a8636ac109
messages.subject: Samplig weight in the context of complex sampling design (e.g., PISA, TIMMS, ICCS)
parts:
Hi there,

I am trying to conduct a cfa with a few items from ICCS (http://www.iea.nl/iccs_2009.html). I was told that the data analysis should considere the weights associated to the sample design. How/where should I tell Lavaan that it needs to consider these weights?

Thank you!

Michael.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Samplig weight in the context of complex sampling design (e.g., PISA, TIMMS, ICCS)

On 05/07/2014 03:54 PM, Michael Filsecker wrote:
> Hi there,
>
> I am trying to conduct a cfa with a few items from ICCS
> (http://www.iea.nl/iccs_2009.html). I was told that the data analysis
> should considere the weights associated to the sample design. How/where
> should I tell Lavaan that it needs to consider these weights?

You need the lavaan.survey package. See:

http://www.jstatsoft.org/v57/i01

Yves.
